label: Light
note: Practical, atmospheric, and studio lighting architecture.

options.label: Penthouse night (cool city-window blue + warm brass lamp amber)
options.rule: intimate penthouse night lighting: cool sapphire-blue moonlight and city skyline glow from floor-to-ceiling windows balanced against warm amber key light from an indoor brass lamp, casting glossy two-tone highlights across skin and furniture.

options.label: Astro Cinema motivated practical (dominant lamp + soft shadow rolloff)
options.rule: motivated practical cinema lighting: a single visible warm practical lamp acts as the dominant key source on one side of the face and torso with gentle highlight rolloff, balanced by soft ambient room bounce in the shadows.

options.label: Deep crimson velvet boudoir + warm gold skin rim
options.rule: crimson and gold boudoir lighting: rich ruby-red ambient fill paired with a warm golden side-rim light that traces every curve of bare skin, collarbones and hips.

options.label: Soft Natural Light (Balanced Diffused Daylight & Smooth Rolloff)
options.rule: soft natural light: balanced, diffused natural daylight wrapping smoothly across skin, hair, and fabric with gradual shadow rolloff, authentic skin tone, and clear soft eye catchlights.

options.label: Soft Natural Window Light (Gentle Side Daylight & Room Falloff)
options.rule: soft natural window light: gentle, diffused daylight entering from one side window across face and torso while the far side of the room settles into smooth ambient shadow falloff.

options.label: Golden sunset venetian-blind stripes across skin
options.rule: golden-hour venetian-blind lighting: warm amber sunset rays sliced through horizontal window blinds into glowing golden stripes across faces, torsos and sheets.

options.label: 2D Anime drawn light (hard two-tone cel shadow + crisp jaw rim wedge)
options.rule: hand-drawn 2D cel lighting: hard two-tone cel shadow shapes across the face and body, a crisp drawn rim-light line along the jaw and shoulder, and a bright white wedge specular highlight in the eyes.

options.label: 🖤 Chiaroscuro Deep-Shadow Slash (Playtime v2.1 Style — Single Hard Key + Pitch-Black Falloff)
options.rule: dramatic high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting: a single razor-sharp directional key light carves across one side of the face and body while the opposite side and surrounding background fall off into deep, velvety pitch-black shadow with bright specular skin highlights.

options.label: ⚡ On-Beat Strobe & Lightning Flash Pulses Out of Darkness
options.rule: rhythmic on-beat strobe lighting: the dark smoke-filled space is punctuated by crisp, high-intensity white and cyan overhead strobe flashes that freeze droplets, hair, and silhouettes in stark relief on each beat.

options.label: 🕯️ Warm Flickering Candlelight Cluster (Deep Amber Skin Glow + Dancing Shadows)
options.rule: intimate flickering candlelight: clusters of real wax candles cast a warm 2200K golden-amber glow across dewy skin and silk sheets while soft, living shadows dance across the walls.

options.label: 🌧️ Wet Window Neon Rain Caustics (Moving Cyan/Magenta Ripples Across Skin)
options.rule: wet neon window caustics: city neon signs shining through rain-streaked glass project slowly sliding cyan and magenta water-ripple patterns across the subject's face, bare shoulders, and bedsheets.

options.label: 🔥 Fireplace Hearth Underglow (Rolling Warm Orange Ember Flicker)
options.rule: fireplace hearth underglow: a crackling open fire at floor level bathes the subjects from a low angle in rolling warm orange-and-copper light with soft golden rim highlights.

options.label: 🚗 Twin Car Headlight Volumetric Fog Beams (High-Contrast Backlit Rim)
options.rule: twin car headlight beams cutting through night mist: two bright, low-mounted halogen headlight cones slice through swirling fog behind the subject, outlining their body in a blazing silver rim halo.

options.label: 💡 Warm Hollywood Vanity Mirror Bulbs (Even Glamour Key + Eye Catchlights)
options.rule: warm vanity mirror globe bulbs: a row of glowing tungsten vanity bulbs around the mirror bathes the face and upper torso in flattering, luminous glamour light with crisp circular catchlights in both eyes.

options.label: 🪩 Nightclub Sweeping Laser & UV Blacklight Haze
options.rule: nightclub laser and UV lighting: electric violet blacklight and sweeping emerald-and-magenta laser fans slice through suspended club haze, catching glossy skin and metallic fabric.

options.label: ❄️ Midnight Open-Fridge / Doorway Cold Spill in Dark Room
options.rule: a single cold directional spill from an open refrigerator or doorway in a dark room: cool crisp white-blue light spills across the subject's front profile while the rest of the kitchen stays in moody midnight shadow.

options.label: ☀️ Morning Sunlight Through Billowing Sheer White Curtains
options.rule: soft morning sunlight streaming through billowing sheer white curtains: airy, diffused golden-white daylight wraps around skin and hair with gentle moving fabric shadows.

options.label: 📺 Flickering Blue Screen / Monitor Glow on Faces in Dark Room
options.rule: flickering screen glow in a dark room: a cool cyan-and-indigo light from an off-camera television or monitor pulses softly across the subject's face and eyes against deep shadow.

options.label: ✨ Pure Golden-Hour Hair & Curve Rim Halo + Soft Warm Fill
options.rule: golden-hour rim backlighting: low warm sun positioned directly behind the subject ignites a glowing halo along their hair strands, shoulders, and hip curves while a soft warm reflector fills their face.

options.label: 💜 Tokyo Love-Hotel Magenta & Ultraviolet Velvet Wash
options.rule: lit by a sultry Tokyo love-hotel lighting scheme: recessed magenta LED coves behind the headboard, deep ultraviolet wall wash, and warm rose-gold specular highlights across bare skin and satin sheets.

options.label: 🛥️ Superyacht Golden-Hour Sun + Shimmering Turquoise Water Caustics
options.rule: lit by low golden-hour Mediterranean sun grazing across the deck paired with dancing turquoise water-reflection caustics rippling upward across the subject's skin and underside of the jaw.

options.label: 🥊 Underground Fight-Club Overhead Cage Halide & Hard Sweat Rim
options.rule: lit by a single harsh industrial metal-halide cage lamp suspended directly overhead in a dark arena, carving razor-sharp silver rim light along sweaty shoulders, knuckles, and rising breath vapor.

options.label: ⚡ Anime2Real Elemental Aura Key — Self-Illuminating Power Glow Casting Colored Shadows
options.rule: lit dynamically by the subject's own blazing elemental aura or weapon energy, which acts as the primary moving key light and casts vivid interactive colored rim highlights and shadows across their face and the surrounding room.

options.label: 🪩 VIP Club UV Blacklight, Neon Pink Tube & Emerald Laser Sheet
options.rule: lit by club UV blacklight that makes white and neon fabrics glow, crossed by a vertical hot-pink neon tube key light and a thin emerald laser fan cutting through the haze.

options.label: 🕯️ Candlelit Obsidian Bath — Hundreds of Floating Tealights & Golden Water Bounce
options.rule: lit entirely by dozens of flickering wax candles and floating tealights reflecting off dark obsidian stone and warm bathwater, wrapping wet skin in a rich, dancing amber-gold glow.

options.label: 📸 Red-Carpet Paparazzi Strobe Barrage — Crisp High-Fashion Xenon Flash Bursts
options.rule: lit by a continuous barrage of crisp, high-powered white paparazzi camera flashes popping from the front and sides, freezing specular diamond and satin highlights against a velvet night backdrop.

options.label: 🌊 Bioluminescent Abyss Cyan & Electric Violet Caustic Glow
options.rule: bioluminescent dark-water lighting: glowing electric-cyan and deep violet luminescence blooming across wet skin, hair, and misty air against velvety deep-sea shadows

options.label: 🏨 Neon Motel Sign & Wet Rain-Glass Crimson/Teal Spill
options.rule: flickering neon motel sign light spilling through a rain-streaked glass window in vibrant cherry-red and cool teal reflections across dark interior surfaces and skin

options.label: 🚗 Sunset Car Interior Golden Lens Flare & Dashboard Amber
options.rule: low golden-hour sunlight slicing cleanly across the car cabin interior with warm amber dashboard reflections and natural sun-flare rim light along shoulders and hair

options.label: 🌙 Warm Candlelight Key + Cool Silver Moonlight Split
options.rule: dual-temperature split lighting: warm flickering amber candlelight grazing one side of the face and torso while cool silver-blue moonlight from an open window traces the opposite silhouette edge

options.label: 📸 Editorial Vogue Softbox Key + Crisp Silver Rim Edge
options.rule: high-fashion studio lighting: a large feathered overhead octabox key sculpting smooth luminous skin tones paired with crisp silver rim strips defining cheekbones, collarbones, and silhouette

options.label: Neon Rain Puddle Uplight (Magenta/Cyan Wet Asphalt Reflections)
options.rule: Lit from below by vibrant magenta and electric cyan neon reflections bouncing off rain-slicked asphalt and wet stone, carving crisp colored rim highlights along jaws, hair, and damp clothes.

options.label: Police Cruiser Red-Blue Alternating Window Strobes
options.rule: Alternating pulses of saturated red and cool cobalt-blue light sweeping through dark blinds or car windows every second, catching sharp wet reflections in eyes and across metal surfaces.

options.label: Crackling Hearth Firelight + Cool Moonlight Window Rim
options.rule: Bathed on one side in warm flickering amber-orange hearth firelight dancing across skin while cool pale-blue moonlight through tall cabin panes outlines the opposite shoulder and hair.

options.label: Storm Lightning Flash Silhouette -> Deep Indigo Shadow
options.rule: Shadowed in deep stormy indigo twilight punctuated by crisp white-blue lightning sheet flashes from behind the window glass that momentarily backlight silhouettes and bright rain sheets.

options.label: Warm Beauty Ringlight Catchlights + Soft Silk Fill
options.rule: Front-lit by a wide soft warm ringlight casting crisp circular highlights inside both irises and wrapping dewy skin in silky, zero-harshness glamour illumination.

options.label: Cool Green-White Subway Fluorescent Tubes + Hard Overhead Shadows
options.rule: Lit by stark overhead cool-emerald and tungsten subway car tubes with crisp downward brow shadows and brief rhythmic light flickers as the train tears through dark tunnel lights.

options.label: Golden Hour Hair Halo Rim Light + Warm Amber Skin Fill
options.rule: Low honey-gold sunset rays pouring directly behind the subjects to ignite hair strands and shoulders in a luminous golden halo while soft warm bounce illuminates expressive faces.

options.label: Classic Three-Point Studio Key & Rim
options.rule: balanced studio three-point lighting with soft warm key light sculpting cheekbones, subtle bounce fill, and crisp hair-separation rim

options.label: Chiaroscuro Deep Shadow Contrast
options.rule: dramatic chiaroscuro lighting pitting one sculpted directional beam against deep velvety unlit shadows

options.label: Rembrandt Cheek-Triangle Key
options.rule: classic 45-degree Rembrandt side key casting a crisp illuminated triangle beneath the far eye with rich sculpted falloff

options.label: Butterfly Overhead Beauty Key
options.rule: overhead centered butterfly beauty lighting casting symmetrical soft glow across brow, cheekbones, and glossy lower lip

options.label: Crisp Hair & Shoulder Rim Backlight
options.rule: bright rear rim backlight carving a luminous glowing halo along hair edges, shoulders, and curved silhouettes

options.label: High-Contrast Backlit Silhouette
options.rule: strong bright window or stage backlight turning the foreground figure into a sleek sculpted dark silhouette

options.label: Golden Hour Low Sun Glow
options.rule: low warm amber late-afternoon sunlight casting long soft shadows and rich honeyed rim glow across skin and hair

options.label: Cool Twilight Blue Hour
options.rule: deep cobalt dusk twilight balanced with small warm interior practical accents

options.label: Diffused Overcast Soft Daylight
options.rule: even, shadowless diffused overcast skylight wrapping softly around skin and fabrics

options.label: Crisp Overhead Midday Sun
options.rule: bright high midday sun throwing short sharp shadows and vivid specular highlights

options.label: Warm Flickering Candlelight
options.rule: intimate flickering amber candlelight dancing softly across skin, silk, and warm shadowed walls

options.label: Cool Silver Moonlight
options.rule: silvery-blue nocturnal moonlight streaming through tall panes across deep shadowed corners

options.label: Vibrant Cyan & Magenta Neon
options.rule: saturated magenta and electric cyan neon signs bathing wet surfaces and skin in crisp colored speculars

options.label: Dual Cyan / Amber Gel Cross-Light
options.rule: contrasting dual-gel lighting: cool electric cyan key from one side balanced by warm amber-crimson rim from the opposite edge

options.label: Venetian Blind Shadow Slats
options.rule: low warm sunlight or streetlamp slicing through venetian blinds into sharp rhythmic diagonal light stripes across face and room

options.label: Volumetric Dust-Beam God Rays
options.rule: visible dusty shafts of directional volumetric sunlight or spotlight slicing cleanly through thin atmospheric haze

options.label: Motivated Practical Table & Sconce Lamps
options.rule: warm shaded practical lamps visible in frame creating intimate glowing pools of light amidst rich room shadow

options.label: Warm Hearth Firelight Glow
options.rule: pulsing orange-amber hearth firelight flickering warmly across skin and textiles

options.label: Cool Monitor / TV Screen Glow
options.rule: soft flickering cool blue screen illumination lighting faces in an otherwise dark room

options.label: Warm Amber Booth Practical & Deep Shadow
options.rule: rich amber booth sconce glow wrapping skin in golden highlights against dark velvet room corners

options.label: Low-Key Sculpted Noir Contrast
options.rule: shadow-dominant low-key lighting illuminating only the essential facial edge and silhouette contour

options.label: Bright Airy High-Key Studio Wrap
options.rule: bright, clean high-key wraparound lighting filling shadows evenly for airy editorial polish

options.label: Dappled Leaf & Lace Shadow Motifs
options.rule: soft organic patches of warm filtered light and leaf shadows shifting gently across skin

options.label: 💡 Epiphany Illumination Shift (Light Finds Face on Realization)
options.rule: motivated key illumination brightening smoothly across the subject's eyes and cheekbone at the exact beat of realization while surrounding shadows stay deep

options.label: 🪟 Gobo / Cucoloris Graphic Shadows (Blinds, Leaves & Grille Patterns)
options.rule: focused hard beam projected through patterned shutters, wrought iron, or foliage throwing crisp alternating bands of light and shadow across skin and walls

options.label: 🎭 Cameo Isolated Pool (Bright Figure Carved Out of Deep Darkness)
options.rule: tightly focused overhead and key pool illuminating only the sculpted subject in warm clarity while the surrounding walls fall away into deep shadow

options.label: ✨ Hard Side-Back Kicker (Razor Cheekbone & Jaw Accent)
options.rule: crisp side-back kicker light slicing a bright metallic ribbon along the far jawline, cheekbone, and shoulder contour
